caption:
Figure 4: Shape selection. We compare one-hot encoding (hard
labels, left) for supervising the shape selection problem with soft
labels (right) which allow for multiple shape predictions at the
same time and are based on geometric similarity, specifically the
Euclidian distance between SDF shape representations.
